name: Brick by Brick
tagline: Film your space and get a buildable LEGO set of it, with a parts list and instructions.

awards: TwelveLabs: Build The Future of Video Understanding with TwelveLabs

problem: The team wanted to rekindle childhood building as a way to reflect on identity.
solution: Video understanding analyses the footage, a spatial-reasoning model maps it into a voxel grid, parts come from a LEGO parts database, and a memory layer switches between lighter and heavier models by complexity.
demo_moment: Team-described: record an object and receive the LEGO pieces and steps to build it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “TwelveLabs: Build The Future of Video Understanding with TwelveLabs” and “Best Use of Solana” among 160 submissions.
Uses video understanding for something physical and playful.
Everyone recognises LEGO, so the output needs no explanation.

lessons: Point a sponsor's model at something tangible and familiar.
